anna: Heads-up: streaming + retry + pagination snippets out of sync across py/ts/go. Found a broken anchor on the migration guide. Can someone own a tiny polyglot cookbook?

chris: I can. single doc with language tabs preferred. examples should be tiny and use the same var names.

vlad: CI note: docs-snippet-check failed on Go due to shared buffer across goroutines. channel-per-stream fixes it.

chris: draft python (compact):
```python
from redwood import Client
c=Client()
resume_token=None
for chunk in c.stream('gpt-xx', prompt='hi'):
    if chunk.type=='resume': resume_token=chunk.token
    print(chunk.text, end='')
if resume_token: c.stream('gpt-xx', resume_token=resume_token)
```

chris: will add ts/go matching `resume_token`/`cursor_id`/`batch_size`.

mai: add a short note: resume tokens are best-effort, may expire (TTL), not exactly-once. also call out batching vs realtime cost/latency tradeoffs.

vlad: minimal Go fix to avoid race: use channel and single writer for resume_token. I'll push a tiny patch.

ci-bot: preview published for branch docs/snippet-resume-lite at https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branch/docs-snippet-resume-lite

anna: acceptance: one polyglot page, consistent var names, docs CI green, migration anchor fixed, TTL callout. I'll review the PR when it's up. :rocket:
